title: Rav Sheshet son of Rav Yehoshua
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.115a.2); Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rav Shisha son of Rav Idi, as in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 115a reads Rav Sheshet son of Rav Yehoshua, agreeing with the supplied heading. Shisha son of Rav Idi is Hyman’s proposed replacement, attributed by him to Dikdukei Soferim.

The linked Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3531&lang=en) name Rav Sheshet son of Rav Yehoshua, following Rav Chisda’s practice. Hyman emphatically proposes Rav Shisha son of Rav Idi from the apparatus he cites.
